description: This Java class 'PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader' implements an asynchronous cache loader for policy enforcers, retrieving policies via an actor-based messaging system and handling responses to produce cache entries.

classes.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: A cache loader that asynchronously loads policy enforcers by querying a shard-region-proxy actor, handling responses to produce cache entries.

methods.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache loader with a timeout and actor reference, setting up command creation and response transformation functions.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an entry for a given entity ID with resource type, delegating to an internal actor-based cache loader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrievePolicyResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from policy retrieval, extracting policy revision and creating cache entries or handling access issues.

methods.name: badPolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a supplier that throws an IllegalStateException for bad policy responses.
